task_summary: Documented no-rental hosting on an existing x86-64 machine and credit-funded Azure for Students hosting with authenticated HTTPS publication.
decisions: Keep the production application and its API, uploads and live updates on one hostname.
Offer ngrok for a limited review group and Cloudflare Access for a pilot with an existing domain.
Distinguish time-limited student credit from ongoing free infrastructure.
verification_notes: Using the nonsecret example and the documented override, Docker Compose resolved six services, one loopback-only port mapping and one private upload bind at /app/uploads. Local guide links resolved. Provider documentation checked. No live deployment or account was created and end-to-end tests were not run.
lessons_learned: The CPU PyTorch wheel pinned by the plagiarism Dockerfile includes a platform-specific version suffix. Verify the architecture before choosing an ARM cloud host.
